items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: At one time we used to get together at Dan's house in afternoos... Almond Hug played piano

ctx.x: Very good tuba on those old records.

He's an excellent musician. At one time we used to get together at Dan's house in afternoons, five saxophone players. And Dan used to scribble little things out and write things for the tunes like Deep River and all pretty things just for the saxophones to play, you know, in afternoons and drink beer and have more or less a saxophone session, a session of saxes, you know. Who would those guys be? Doc Randeau and Eddie Miller and myself and Almond Hug played piano and a couple other fellas, like probably fellas…
Okay, let's see. I think you'd better get a little closer to the mic. We were talking about Dan LeBlanc going over to his house.
